Our story

Travel with people who know the way.

Muskan Travel & Tours was established in Kathmandu in June 2004. What began with a strong foundation in air ticketing has grown into a full-service travel company arranging inbound Nepal experiences and outbound journeys around the world.

We combine market knowledge with warm Nepali hospitality—so every traveller receives practical advice, fair value and professional support.
